gaps.sentence: He ___ forgets to bring the tickets, as usual (TYPICAL).
gaps.hint: adverb of frequency needed to modify 'forgets' (-ly)
gaps.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb 'forgets': typically means in the usual way.

gaps.sentence: The success of the launch rests on the ___ (RELY) of the supplier.
gaps.explanation: 'The reliability of the supplier' — the quality noun is needed after 'the'.

gaps.sentence: The trip gave us a lot of ___ (PLEASE).
gaps.explanation: 'A lot of' needs a noun: pleasure (note the irregular spelling).

gaps.sentence: His ___ (DETERMINE) to become a doctor never wavered.
gaps.explanation: A noun is needed after 'His': determination (-ation noun); 'determined' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IDENTIFY) of the body took weeks.
gaps.hint: noun: the act of establishing who
gaps.explanation: 'The identification of the body' — the process noun is required.

gaps.sentence: The firefighter was given a medal for her ___ (HERO).
gaps.explanation: 'Her heroism' — the quality noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The ___ between rich and poor is widening (DIVIDE).
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: division (-sion). 'Divisive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: He is under a lot of ___ at work (PRESS).
gaps.hint: noun needed after 'a lot of'; fixed phrase 'under ___'
gaps.explanation: 'Under pressure' is the fixed phrase; the noun of 'press' is 'pressure'.
